source.label: Group sales email export and enriched addresses

metricDefinitions.label: Email count
metricDefinitions.definition: Count individual email records in the supplied export, including received, sent and automatic replies unless filtered.

metricDefinitions.label: Hourly average
metricDefinitions.definition: For each hour 00–23, count matching emails and divide by selected calendar days within the export date bounds; include days with no matching email records. A selected single day has denominator one.

metricDefinitions.label: Geography
metricDefinitions.definition: Each message inherits the external-contact/business address assigned to its conversation. This is not necessarily the physical location of its sender. Geography bars count distinct conversations with at least one matching email.

caveats: This is a selected export of 100 conversations, not a complete mailbox history. Zero means no matching records in this export.
Timestamp timezone is unspecified; times are shown unchanged. First and last dates and months have partial coverage.
Addresses may come from signatures, company-office matches, or geographic inference; some contact branches are unconfirmed.

evidenceFlow.title: Source join
evidenceFlow.detail: Read JSON email objects and join enriched CSV on Conversation ID, retaining one row per email. Full readable message content is available separately in the conversation reader.

evidenceFlow.title: Reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: 427 email rows across 100 conversations. Timestamp parsing and unique row identities checked.

classificationDefinitions.label: Scope
classificationDefinitions.definition: 427 email records and 100 conversation IDs in the supplied export; not a complete mailbox or a count of unique bookings.

classificationDefinitions.label: Status
classificationDefinitions.definition: Enquiry, Confirmed, Automatic reply, Other, or Needs review. Confirmed means customer commitment or evidenced existing booking/service, not proof that every supplier service is confirmed or paid.

classificationDefinitions.label: New enquiry
classificationDefinitions.definition: First request in that conversation, directly visible or forwarded. One per conversation at most. A thread beginning with an existing quotation, follow-up or amendment is not labelled new merely because it is the first exported record.

classificationDefinitions.label: Existing enquiry
classificationDefinitions.definition: A follow-up, quotation, reply or amendment to a request. Only used while status is Enquiry.

classificationDefinitions.label: Missing history
classificationDefinitions.definition: New means first request visible in this export, not a verified first contact anywhere in the mailbox. Quoted first requests have not been manufactured into extra email rows.

classificationDefinitions.label: Category
classificationDefinitions.definition: Only assigned on new-enquiry email rows when explicitly supported. Private requires private travel-service wording; Pvt Ltd company names do not count. Mix means private AND shared/SIC services, as defined by the user. FIT requires an explicit travel-category mention. None are inferred from passenger counts, mixed hotel ratings or budgets. Blank means not explicitly established.

classificationDefinitions.label: Current conversation status
classificationDefinitions.definition: Status at the latest exported message. Earlier emails retain the evidence available at their timestamp; a later confirmation is not backfilled into earlier emails.

classificationDefinitions.label: Evidence
classificationDefinitions.definition: Status evidence includes source conversation and message timestamp. Quoted history is explicitly identified; its observation date is not necessarily the actual confirmation date.

classificationDefinitions.label: Related threads
classificationDefinitions.definition: Same normalized subject or explicit TDU/TJHLDQN reference flags possible related conversations. Conversation IDs are retained and are not claimed to be unique leads/bookings.

classificationDefinitions.label: Review
classificationDefinitions.definition: Medium-confidence operational classifications and missing/ambiguous first requests should be reviewed. No attachments beyond readable content were used to prove confirmation.

source.locationDisplayRule: For a conversation whose latest exported sender uses @turtledownunder.com.au, missing city/region/country fields display Turtle Down Under. This is a sender label, not a geographic location. Verified location fields are unchanged; originalCity/originalRegion/originalCountry preserve source values. External latest senders retain Unknown.

quoted: Thank you for your detailed email and for proceeding to launch the New Zealand package. Please find below TDU point-wise reply.

1. We need a quote for (a) the approximate cost based on triple sharing. Please also specify whether this involves a properly triple-bedded room or an extra bed in a double-bedded room. (b) Child with an extra bed, (c) Child without an extra bed (d) Infant up to 4 years (e) Single Supplement.
Slab-wise Quote attached with all costs. Triple room at hotels are majorly with Extra Bed. Infant costs differ as per height at attractions.
2. In Franz Josef, lunch & dinner are provided at a local restaurant but they will be vegetarian meals. Please also confirm if Jain meals are possible.
Yes, Vegetarian meals will be provided at local restaurants. Jain meals are subject to availability as per ingridents available at local restaurant.
3. Will lunch and dinner be provided in a separate, earmarked area or in a common space where non-veg meals are also served?
For Groups, major restaurants place Buffet meals and all dishes are placed adjacent to each other.
4. One FOC will be provided (on a double-sharing basis).
FOC as mentioned are provided by hotel on minimum 10/12 paid rooms as per hotel policy. 01 FOC for Tour Manager will be provided on 20 paid pax
Tips are not mandatory in Australia and New Zealand. Group can give them as per their preferences.
6. If any guest wants a local or non veg meal, is it possible?
For Groups, meals at Indian restaurant are provided in Buffet. Additional requirement will be at additional cost OR guest needs to purchase directly. Cost reduction wont be provided.
Hope the above is in order.
Await your confirmation in order to secure rooms and services as February is peak season across Australia and New Zealand.

main: As we discussed, please find below Upgraded Option for Moreton Tour as it only operates September onwards.
-Desert Safari Day Cruise with Wild Dolphin Feeding Package.
-Return Scenic Catamatan Cruise across Moreton Bay Marine Park, from Brisbane to Tangalooma
-4WD Bus ride from Tangalooma to Desert
-Island Lunch voucher(AUD 25 Per Adult, AUD 20 Per Child)
-1 x Tea, Coffee or Soft Drink per guest to use at anytime onboard the passenger ferry
-Resort access pass allowing use of resort facilities including tow swimming pools, restaurant and bars (as time permits)

Experience the magic of meeting wild bottlenose dolphins. While they visit almost every night, this is an experience with wild animals, where dolphin welfare and guest safety come first. Feeding is subject to weather, dolphin behaviour and the number of dolphins that visit the feed on a particular night, so we cannot guarantee every eligible guest will hand-feed a dolphin.
To ensure the programs sustainability, sometimes guests will have to share one fish per group.

For safety purposes, sometimes eligible guests may be directed to throw their fish from the jetty. In the very rare event that no dolphins visit or theres a jetty feed, eligible guests will receive a return voucher. Voucher redemption conditions apply.

rows.subject: Fw: MELBOURNE GROUP : 110 - 120 PAX : OCT TRAVEL
quoted: Vidhi Thaker <vidhi.thaker@riya.travel>; Abhishek Sonthalia <abhisheks@turtledownunder.com.au>; Turtle Down Under - Accounts <accounts@turtledownunder.com.au>
Please note that we have a group of approx 110 - 120 pax traveling to Melbourne. Based on the details below,
please share the quotes with the itinerary.
Hotel 5 star city center Hotel (international chain of hotels only)
Hot Buffet Breakfast (American Breakfast) is a must.
All meals should be 2 Veg + 2 Non veg Main Dish + Dal + Rice + assorted Indian Bread Naan /Roti + Salad +Pickel, Papad, Yogurt + 1 Dessert + water
All rooms should have a tea/coffee maker in the room.
2 Indian Dishes + Masala Tea during breakfast is a must.

We require a ballroom at the hotel for an Award Ceremony followed by a Gala Dinner on one day during their stay. The program for this day will start around 17:00 hrs. We need 1 tea/coffee break, and the ballroom must be pillar-less.

Gala Dinner (Indian Food) includes with 3 hours free flow of soft drinks, mixtures, beer, 2 veg + 2 non veg starter (hot starters should be pass around)... we will bring duty free alcohol and corkage to be waived off. During this event we need Cluster Style seating with table covers & chair covers.
- Please advise if there are any new adventure activities which can be added with optional cost and details.
- Conference event set up - Stage + Podium with mic + Teleprompter + LED Screen for Backdrop + Sound & Light + clicker for slide change + 3 cordless mics + 2
Pls share the ballroom dimensions with pictures.
- DJ with sound system for conference & Gala Dinner
G/2, Leela Business Park, Andheri Kurla Road, Andheri (East),
